key_insight: Combining standardized trial data with vaccine and adverse-event ontologies improved semantic trial retrieval and adverse-event ranking in vaccine research.
clinical_relevance: This framework could support vaccine trial evidence review and study planning, but it does not establish patient-level clinical benefit.
method: Mapped 9,147 vaccine study records from AACT into SEA-CDM.
Linked vaccines and reported adverse events to VO and OAE ontologies in relational tables and a Neo4j knowledge graph.
Evaluated semantic retrieval, adverse-event ranking, trial similarity, and machine-learning design recommendations.
evidence_signal: Ontology-expanded retrieval found 41 candidate RNA vaccine trials versus 16 with exact identifier matching, while context-aware adverse-event ranking improved recall@10 from 0.317 to 0.383.
watch_item: Design-recommendation performance varied across 23 vaccine classes, warranting further validation before practical use.
paper_title: Ontology-Based SEA-CDM Integration for Vaccine Clinical Trials: Query, Similarity, and Design Recommendation
